description: Untouched replacement formal held-out sources for the frozen live tool/LLM experiment. These sources were frozen offline before any v3 run and are disjoint from every development, tuning, frozen-development, and formal-v2 source. Each authoritative Wikipedia visit URL was committed before execution; this split must not be inspected for tuning, load selection, or parameter selection.
